### Articles

- The Universalist Divide: Cleavages, Identities, and Party Preferences in the EU (2026). *Journal of European Public Policy* 33(2), 495–527 (with Delia Zollinger, Silja Häusermann, Simon Bornschier, and Lukas Haffert).
- Realignment within the Right Field: Competition between the Mainstream Right and the Far Right (2026). *West European Politics* 49(3), 812–840 (with Silja Häusermann, Simon Bornschier, and Delia Zollinger).
- Mapping Ignorance: A Scoping Review of Political and Communication Studies on Ignorance (2025). *Review of Communication* 25(4), 250–266 (with Maud Reveilhac).
- Multidimensional Party Polarization in Europe: Cross-Cutting Divides and Effective Dimensionality (2025). *British Journal of Political Science*. Accepted for publication (with Jelle Koedam and Garret Binding).
- Causal Inference with Latent Outcomes (2024). *American Journal of Political Science*. Early view (with Lukas F. Stoetzer and Xiang Zhou).
- The Comparative Meaning of Political Space: A Comprehensive Modeling Approach (2024). *Political Science Research and Methods* 12(3), 643–651 (with Garret Binding and Jelle Koedam).
- The Russian Threat and the Consolidation of the West: How Populism and EU-Skepticism Shape Party Support for Ukraine (2024). *European Union Politics* 25(3), 459–482 (with Liesbet Hooghe, Gary Marks, Ryan Bakker, Seth Jolly, Jonathan Polk, Jan Rovny, and Milada Anna Vachudova).
- The Social Bases of Political Parties: A New Measure and Survey (2023). *British Journal of Political Science* 53(1), 249–260 (with Gary Marks, David Attewell, Liesbet Hooghe, and Jan Rovny).
